newsitem.title: JAPAN: Russia platinum body says delaying Japan visit.
newsitem.headline: Russia platinum body says delaying Japan visit.

text.p: Russian platinum group metal agency Almazjuvelirexport said on Tuesday it would delay sending a delegation to Japan to negotiate its annual export contract for 1997 until January or February.
The Russian platinum body usually sends a delegation to Japan in mid-December for talks with Japanese clients on the following year's export contracts.

"The mission will be a bit delayed until January or February," said a Russian trade representative in Tokyo. He said budget problems on the part of the Russian side were behind the delays. He did not elaborate.
